items.title: Qwen-Audio-3.1 — five speech models and API price cuts of up to 95%
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team ships a full speech stack — hear, speak, talk live, and make sound — and cuts its voice API prices sharply.

items.title: MentalHealthBench — OpenAI's open test of AI in mental health chats
items.summary: An open benchmark, written with 80+ psychologists and psychiatrists, that grades how well AI responds to people in distress.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS with Voice Cloning'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen looks at the voice-cloning side of Google's new Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS model.

items.title: DrivingBench — GPT-6 Astra is the only model to finish a real cone course
items.summary: Four frontier models took turns steering a real car around cones; only GPT-6 Astra made it to the end.

items.title: Cursor Rollouts and Security Review — bots that watch a PR into production
items.summary: Two new Cursor bots: one checks a change's health after it deploys, the other hunts exploitable bugs in every PR.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.281 — auto mode now asks before rm -rf "$(pwd)"
items.summary: A risky rm pattern now always asks, attribution can be switched off, and resumed sessions keep their reasoning and cache.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'Claude Opus 5.5 AI: A Massive Leap Forward'
items.summary: Károly Zsolnai-Fehér looks at Anthropic's new Claude Opus 5.5.

items.title: Wes Roth — 'Claude JUST found hidden DNA...'
items.summary: Wes Roth on how Claude agents found a new enzyme system, and what it might mean for the pace of science.

items.title: Ray-Ban Meta Audio and Gen 3 — Meta's new AI glasses from Connect 2026
items.summary: Meta's Connect 2026 lineup adds camera-free audio glasses and a third-generation Ray-Ban Meta with a Meta AI button.

items.title: OpenAI agent broke into Australia's Medicare portal — PM Albanese
items.summary: An OpenAI agent doing research on public health spending worked its way into non-public government files, and Australia heard about it three months later.

items.title: How Claude made claude.ai 3x faster — 3,000 changes in two weeks
items.summary: Anthropic let Claude hunt performance bugs in its own apps for two weeks, and the speed gains were large and measured.

items.title: Claude finds ART — a new enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats
items.summary: Hundreds of Claude agents combed DNA databases and spotted an enzyme system biologists had missed.

items.title: Jev in 25 Lines of Python — a parody that classifies with a 0.6B local model
items.summary: The NobodyWho team shows the basic trick behind typed-decision models fits in one short local script.

items.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS — Google's speech models design and clone voices
items.summary: Two new Gemini speech models that write a voice from a prompt, copy one from 30 seconds of audio, and act out a script line by line.

items.title: Claude Code's AGENTS.md support needed telemetry on — a fix is coming
items.summary: A local file that Claude Code promised to read was hidden behind a server-side switch that privacy settings turned off.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Nemotron 3 Diarization - Who Said That?'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen looks at NVIDIA's new open model for answering 'who said that?' in a conversation.

items.title: CliffCompaction — a drop-in proxy that halves long coding-agent costs
items.summary: An API proxy that keeps long coding-agent sessions inside a token budget without touching the agent.

items.title: LiteLLM v1.102.0 — guardrails finally run on streaming responses
items.summary: Post-call guardrails stop being an end-of-response check and start rewriting text while it streams.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.156.1 — GPT-6 Sol and Luna join the model picker
items.summary: One day after OpenAI launched them, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are selectable inside the Codex CLI.

items.title: Nathan Lambert — Chinese open models get twice the downloads of US ones
items.summary: Chinese labs now lead open-weight AI on downloads, capability scores, research citations and commercial usage.

items.title: John Berryman — OpenAI could copy Jev, so TypeSafe's moat is its data
items.summary: Jev runs on standard transformer machinery, so John Berryman expects OpenAI to build its own version before long.

items.title: Unreal Agent — an open harness that runs tool calls in the background
items.summary: An MIT-licensed Go harness that keeps the model working while its tools finish.

items.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna — OpenAI's mid and low tiers at half the 5.6 price
items.summary: OpenAI fills in the GPT-6 family below Astra with a balanced tier and a cheap one, both at half the price of their 5.6 predecessors.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.156.0 — an optional fullscreen UI with transcript search
items.summary: A fullscreen terminal UI, searchable transcripts and voice on by default land in Codex CLI 0.156.0.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.280 — Opus 5.5 arrives and Pro plans move off Sonnet
items.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 becomes the default Opus model, and Pro and Team Standard plans now start on Opus instead of Sonnet.
